description: The file is an HTML document that defines the user interface for a web-based database viewer application, including styles and embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and display.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing database entries to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data rows into an HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a cell, handling different data types including objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for detailed view.
